items.source:
Strategy interface to filter the list of persistent managed types to include
in the persistence unit. Only class names that match the filter are managed.
items.translation: 用于过滤要包含在持久化单元中的持久化管理类型列表的策略接口。仅匹配过滤器中类名的类会被管理。

items.source: Test if the given class name matches the filter.
items.translation: 测试给定的类名是否与过滤器匹配。

items.source: className - the fully qualified class name of the persistent type to test
items.translation: className - 要测试的持久化类型的完全限定类名

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
